markdown.headingText: Master of Business Administration — Finance & Business Analytics (2025–2026)
markdown.markdown:
Education **University Canada West, Vancouver** - Strong academic performance in Financial Management, Corporate Finance, Business Analytics, and Quantitative Decision Making. - Built advanced models using NPV, IRR, profitability index, and multi-scenario sensitivity analysis to support strategic capital decisions. - Completed applied financial projects including forecasting, cost optimization, and performance evaluation studies. - Developing expertise in evidence-based management, risk evaluation, and analytical frameworks supporting corporate strategy. ### Bachelor of Commerce — Accounting & Finance (2011) **Mumbai University, India** - Graduated First Rank with academic distinction in finance and accounting coursework. - Developed core competencies in financial reporting, management accounting, corporate finance, and regulatory compliance. - Strengthened analytical skills through work in taxation, audit, financial statement interpretation, and quantitative analysis. - Gained foundational expertise in financial reporting, audit, corporate finance, and taxation.
Professional Experience ### Graduate Projects & Applied Learning — University Canada West (2024–Present) - Conducted comprehensive capital budgeting evaluations using NPV, IRR, sensitivity, and payback metrics. - Collaborated on case studies examining organizational performance, cost efficiency, and risk exposure. - Developed budgeting models, variance analyses, and multi-year financial forecasts. - Applied structured project management to ensure timely deliverables and clear communication. - Utilized financial analytics tools to support managerial decisions around cost control and profitability. ### Freelance Financial Analyst (2021–2023) - Designed interactive financial forecasting dashboards in Excel and Power BI, improving client budgeting accuracy by up to 20%. - Produced financial statements, cash-flow analyses, and variance reports to strengthen strategic planning for small businesses. - Delivered tailored insights on pricing, cost structure, and profit improvement. - Built scenario-based financial models to support growth and risk evaluation. - Supported clients with proper financial documentation aligned with accounting standards.
Core Skills & Competencies ### Financial & Analytical Skills - Financial Modelling & Forecasting - Corporate Finance & Valuation - Capital Budgeting (NPV, IRR, Payback, Sensitivity Analysis) - Cost Management & Budgeting - Scenario Planning & Performance Evaluation - Financial Reporting & Documentation ### Data & Technical Skills - Excel (Advanced): Power Query, Solver, Dashboards, PivotTables - Power BI: DAX, interactive dashboards, data modelling - Tableau: data storytelling and visualization - Forecasting & quantitative analytics ### Business & Leadership Skills - Project coordination & workflow management - Professional communication (reports & presentations) - Leadership and teamwork in multicultural environments - Conflict resolution & collaborative problem-solving - Ethical decision-making and a high degree of accuracy
Volunteer Experience ### Event Support — Primary School Programs (2023-2025) - Assisted teachers and staff in organizing academic and cultural events for primary school students. - Helped coordinate student participation, manage event logistics, and support smooth event flow. - Contributed to creating an engaging and supportive environment for young learners. - Strengthened teamwork, communication, and leadership skills through community involvement. ### Event Organizer — College Events (2009- 2011) - Actively participated in planning and executing college events, including seminars, cultural festivals, and student-led competitions. - Managed registration, scheduling, and coordination with faculty and student committees. - Assisted with stage management, logistics, and crowd coordination to ensure successful event execution. - Demonstrated initiative, organization, and collaboration in a fast-paced environment.
